description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal, choosing to pay its replicate cost once, by paying a total of {U}{U}{U}{U}, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Narset's Reversal's replicate ability triggers, creating a copy of it targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the second copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
